feasibility_benchmark_metadata.target_host: Apple Silicon Mac mini M6 (12 cores: 2 Super, 4 Performance, 6 Efficiency; 24 GB Unified Memory)

executive_summary: Local talking-head generation on Apple Silicon Mac mini M6 is currently infeasible for commercial, zero-cost production.
All candidate local avatar models (SadTalker, Wav2Lip, MuseTalk, LivePortrait) require NVIDIA CUDA extensions,
exceed pre-download checkpoint size limits (1.2 GB to 4.5 GB), carry restrictive Non-Commercial licenses (CC BY-NC 4.0),
or suffer severe CPU emulation latency (RTF > 15x). In accordance with the blueprint protocol, fake workarounds
(such as static portraits or idle audio-reactive loops) are strictly rejected. The custom topic-tutorial pipeline
must implement graceful fallback: presenter beats automatically route to high-engagement visual scenes
(animated diagrams, charts, terminal showcases) and mark presenter generation as 'skipped_unavailable'
unless an explicit pay-per-use cloud avatar provider (e.g. HeyGen or Kling) is human-approved.

candidates_evaluated.commercial_compliance: FAILED — Prohibits monetized or commercial production
candidates_evaluated.pre_download_gate_status: BLOCKED — Exceeds 500 MB gate, requires external storage and explicit approval

evaluation_dimensions.1_installation_and_dependencies: FAILED — Depends on face3d C++ extensions compiled specifically for NVIDIA CUDA and MSVC/GCC nvcc. Fails build on macOS ARM64.
evaluation_dimensions.2_compute_backend: FAILED — Hard-coded PyTorch CUDA tensor calls (.cuda()); no native MPS (Metal) support in model graph.
evaluation_dimensions.3_peak_memory_consumption: ESTIMATED > 14 GB unified memory under CPU emulation, causing high swapping risk on 24 GB host.
evaluation_dimensions.4_generation_runtime_and_rtf: ESTIMATED RTF 15.0 - 25.0x under CPU fallback (approx 180s to 300s for a 12s clip).
evaluation_dimensions.5_lip_sync_and_visual_quality: Uncanny valley, mouth tearing, and head warping artifacts common on non-CUDA quantized weights.
evaluation_dimensions.7_audio_video_alignment: Susceptible to frame-drop drift under CPU processing.
evaluation_dimensions.8_license_obligations: CC BY-NC 4.0 restricts usage to non-commercial academic research.

technical_blockers: Missing NVIDIA CUDA hardware and driver support on Apple Silicon macOS
C++ compilation failure of face3d on Apple clang 21.0.0
Non-commercial license forbids general production use
